name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: A pack of official add-ons that teach the Cursor AI coding tool specific tricks, like reviewing code harder or remembering team habits.
buyer: A dev-tooling consultant who sets up AI coding tools for client engineering teams and wants ready-made, credible plugins to install.
business_use_cases: A consultancy customizes one of these plugins (e.g. the security/code-review one) into an enterprise rollout package.
A freelance developer builds and sells a niche industry-specific plugin (e.g. for fintech compliance review) on top of the spec.
An agency uses the reference plugins to pitch 'Cursor setup as a service' to teams migrating to AI-assisted coding.

money_ideas.idea: One-off custom plugin development for a client's engineering team
Retainer consulting for ongoing AI coding tool rollout and maintenance

steal_this: Build one niche vertical plugin this weekend (e.g. for a specific framework or compliance need) and sell it as a paid install.
